dates.note: Kashmiri poet-dramatist; stotra commented by Ksemaraja (KSTS X)

name: Bhattanarayana
summary: Kashmiri poet-dramatist in the Trika orbit: the Venisamhara drama and the Stavacintamani stotra (121 verses) — the latter carrying Ksemaraja's commentary (KSTS X), which brings the court poet into the recognition fold.
